title: Exact separable bounds for covariant entanglement witnesses in every dimension and the absence of non-decomposable mirrors, with a correction to Quantum Sci. Technol. 11, 015037 (2026)
description:
Manuscript, deterministic verification script and figure script on mirrored entanglement witnesses. A mirrored witness is obtained from a witness W by reflection at its separable upper bound, M = u_W 1 - W.

Main results. (1) For the circulant, diagonally covariant operators W_alpha = sum_{i,k} alpha_k |i,i+k><i,i+k| - sum_{i != j} |ii><jj| on C^n (x) C^n, the separable upper bound is determined exactly for every dimension n ≥ 2 and all real parameters: u_W is the largest of alpha_0, ..., alpha_{n-1} and of the numbers ((alpha_0+1)^2 - alpha_k alpha_{n-k}) / (2(alpha_0+1) - alpha_k - alpha_{n-k}), 1 ≤ k ≤ n/2, and it is attained on product vectors supported on two levels. (2) The upper bound is proved by an explicit decomposition u_W 1 - W_alpha = P + Q^Gamma with P, Q ≥ 0. Consequently mu 1 - W_alpha is block positive if and only if it is decomposable: in no dimension does a witness of this family have a non-decomposable mirror, with no optimality assumption. (3) For W[1,...,1,0] the bound is 4/3 for n = 3 (the Choi witness) and 3/2 for every n ≥ 4. (4) Correction to J. Seong, A. Bera, B. C. Hiesmayr, D. Chruściński and J. Bae, Quantum Sci. Technol. 11, 015037 (2026): the operator (4/3)1 - W[1,1,1,0] given there as the mirrored witness of the 4 (x) 4 witness W[1,1,1,0] has expectation value -1/6 on the product vector (|0>+|2>)(|0>-|2>)/2 and is not an entanglement witness; the correct constant is 3/2, the corrected mirror is decomposable, and the PPT states proposed there are not detected. (5) An isometric embedding carries a non-decomposable mirrored pair from 3 (x) 3 to every n (x) n, n ≥ 4. (6) The other explicit examples of the audited paper were recomputed; its three-dimensional and remaining 4 (x) 4 statements are confirmed and six minor inconsistencies are listed.

Contents: the manuscript (PDF and LaTeX source), verify_mirrored_witnesses.py (83 deterministic checks, the decisive ones in exact rational or symbolic arithmetic; requires NumPy and SymPy), the complete output of a verification run, make_figures.py and the three figures.

Scope: the audit used arXiv:2510.06863v2 and was not compared line by line with the version of record.
